reports.title: Korea Market Sample Report
reports.summary: Sample Korea report: route clarity, repeat-trip discovery, localized Korean templates, and seasonal planning are ready for review-gated content experiments.
recommendations: Start with route clarity content for first-time planners.
Use visual route frames instead of generic landmark montage.
Keep Korean replies concise, polite, and review-gated.

reports.title: Taiwan Market Sample Report
reports.summary: Sample Taiwan report: Traditional Chinese family routes, repeat-trip ideas, and seasonal content can be packaged into deep guides and saveable social posts.
recommendations: Start with family route planning and clear transport details.
Use Traditional Chinese tone and avoid Simplified Chinese phrasing.
Verify festival dates before using seasonal festival content.
